company_info.industry_info: Banking and Financial Services. Scotiabank is a Canadian multinational bank and one of Canada's Big Five banks. It operates in personal and commercial banking, wealth management, private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets across the Americas and globally.
company_info.recent_news: In January 2026, Scotiabank confirmed layoffs of approximately 3,000 employees (3% of global workforce) through a multi-quarter restructuring program in late 2025. The restructuring included workforce rationalization in lower-growth areas, with a $373 million restructuring charge recorded in Q4 2025.
company_info.company_culture: According to Glassdoor, 74% of Scotiabank employees would recommend working there to a friend. The company is rated 3.7 out of 5 for work-life balance. Employees highlight a supportive and friendly atmosphere, strong team dynamics, and commitment to diversity. The company emphasizes an inclusive and high-performing culture.
company_info.any_related_information: The Global Wealth Engineering (GWE) team is focused on modernizing and enhancing client and account onboarding platforms for Scotia Wealth Management. The role involves working with agile teams, architects, business stakeholders, and compliance groups. Scotiabank serves over 25 million customers globally with approximately $1.5 trillion in total assets. The company is headquartered in Toronto, Ontario.
